claims.text: What fluoroscopy is A continuous X-ray beam gives real-time images of moving structures, most often with contrast, as in swallowing studies
claims.quote:
A continuous x-ray beam is used to produce real-time images of moving structures or objects. Fluoroscopy is most often used:
With contrast agents (eg, in swallowing studies or coronary artery catheterization)

claims.text: Video is especially useful for motility disorders such as achalasia
claims.quote: Either video or plain radiographs can be taken for documentation, but video is particularly useful when assessing motor disorders (eg, cricopharyngeal spasm, achalasia).
claims.locator: Radiographs and Contrast Studies of the Abdomen

claims.text: Reading the contrast Single-contrast studies fill the lumen with radiopaque material, outlining the structure
claims.quote: Single-contrast studies fill the lumen with radiopaque material, outlining the structure.
claims.locator: Radiographs and Contrast Studies of the Abdomen

claims.text: Double-contrast studies coat the mucosa with barium while gas distends the organ, giving more detail
claims.quote: Better, more detailed images are obtained from double-contrast studies, in which a small amount of high-density barium coats the mucosal surface and gas distends the organ and enhances contrast.
claims.locator: Radiographs and Contrast Studies of the Abdomen

claims.text: Barium enema: single-contrast for possible obstruction, diverticulitis, fistulas and megacolon; double-contrast is preferred for finding tumors
claims.quote: Single-contrast barium enemas are used for potential obstruction, diverticulitis, fistulas, and megacolon. Double-contrast studies are preferred for detection of tumors.

claims.text: Safety Suspected perforation is a contraindication: free barium irritates the mediastinum and peritoneum; water-soluble contrast is less irritating and may be used
claims.quote: Perforation is a contraindication because free barium is highly irritating to the mediastinum and peritoneum; water-soluble contrast is less irritating and may be used if perforation is possible.
claims.locator: Radiographs and Contrast Studies of the Abdomen

claims.text: Barium enema in toxic megacolon can cause perforation
claims.quote: Perforation can occur if barium enema is done in a patient with toxic megacolon.
claims.locator: Radiographs and Contrast Studies of the Abdomen

claims.text: Fluoroscopy may involve high radiation doses
claims.quote: Fluoroscopy may involve high doses of radiation

claims.text: In practice Endoscopy has largely replaced barium studies of the esophagus, stomach and upper intestine
claims.quote: Endoscopic procedures have largely replaced barium contrast studies of the esophagus, stomach, and upper intestinal tract.
claims.locator: Variations of Conventional Radiography, Contrast studies
